profile.name: Sonu Mandal
profile.summary: MERN Stack Developer and BCA student (CGPA 8.48) with a backend internship and 2 live full-stack applications deployed. Experienced in building REST APIs with Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB, and in implementing JWT authentication, Google OAuth, Razorpay payments and MVC architecture across 3 backend projects.

projects.title: SkillArena — MERN Stack Coding & DSA Platform
projects.shortDescription: High-performance coding and DSA practice platform with live test case execution, XP scoring, and real-time leaderboard ranking.
keyHighlights: Engineered a MERN-stack coding and DSA practice platform with JWT-secured user sessions, deployed live.
Implemented REST endpoints across 5 feature areas: challenge management, code submissions, XP scoring, user statistics and leaderboard ranking.
Designed Mongoose models and MVC controllers, integrated with a React.js frontend.
Engineered robust schema validations and error-handling pipelines for reliable submission evaluations.
apiFeatures: POST /api/challenges/submit — Evaluate user code & award XP dynamically
GET /api/leaderboard — Compute real-time rank ordering based on global XP
GET /api/user/stats — Aggregate solved challenges & streak metrics

projects.title: Grocery Website — Full Stack E-Commerce Application
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack MERN e-commerce store with dual auth (JWT & Google OAuth), inventory management, and complete Razorpay payment integration.
keyHighlights: Developed a full-stack e-commerce platform on the MERN stack with MVC architecture, deployed live.
Architected REST APIs for 4 modules (products, cart, orders, users), each supporting full CRUD operations.
Secured routes with 2 authentication methods: JWT sessions and Google OAuth, restricting sensitive endpoints to logged-in users.
Integrated the Razorpay payment gateway, enabling an end-to-end checkout flow from shopping cart to paid order confirmation.
apiFeatures: POST /api/payment/razorpay/order — Generate secure order signature & keys
POST /api/payment/verify — Verify Razorpay cryptographic HMAC webhook/payload
GET /api/cart & PUT /api/cart — Atomic cart synchronization per authenticated user

projects.title: Hostel Booking System — Backend API Services
projects.shortDescription: Modular backend services managing hostel room allocations, room availability checks, pricing tiers, and Postman-tested REST APIs.
keyHighlights: Delivered backend services for hostel room booking, covering room creation, updates and availability checks.
Added validation and error handling to keep data consistent and API responses reliable.
Tested every endpoint in Postman throughout development, maintaining 100% test scenario coverage.
Structured modular Express routes following clean separation of concerns and MVC pattern.
apiFeatures: GET /api/rooms/availability — Dynamic check across date ranges and room tiers
POST /api/rooms — Admin-protected room creation with validation middleware
POST /api/bookings — Atomically book room with double-booking prevention

responsibilities: Maintained and extended backend features in Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB, following MVC architecture.
Wrote and tested REST API endpoints, resolving bugs to improve response reliability and error resilience.
Collaborated with the development team on code reviews, Git workflows, and production deployments.

highlights: Specialized in Full Stack Web Development, Cloud Computing, and Database Management Systems.
Maintained academic excellence with an 8.48 CGPA across semesters.

certifications.title: Backend Developer Internship Certificate
certifications.description: Verified practical internship experience in Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and REST API development.
